test_title: PYST 54: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 21 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The AI Centre of Excellence for Education announced in Union Budget 2025 is intended to benefit which sector the most?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Education**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The announcement of an **AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) for Education** in the **Union Budget 2025** (referring to the fiscal cycle of **2024-25**) is a core component of the "Make AI in India and Make AI Work for India" initiative.
 
• The primary objective of this centre is to revolutionize the **Education** sector by integrating **Artificial Intelligence** into teaching methodologies, personalized learning, and administrative frameworks. ***Hence, the option Education is correct.***
 
• These centres are designed to facilitate **interdisciplinary research** between top **Educational Institutions** and leading industry players to develop scalable AI solutions for the masses.
 
• By focusing on **Education**, the government aims to improve **learning outcomes**, reduce the dropout rate, and provide **data-driven insights** for curriculum reform.
 
• The initiative directly supports the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**, which advocates for the extensive use of **Technology** in teaching and learning, especially in local languages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sectoral CoEs:** While the focus here is on **Education**, the government has previously identified three specific areas for AI Centres of Excellence: **Agriculture**, **Health**, and **Sustainable Cities**.
 
• **Viksit Bharat @ 2047:** The integration of AI into **Education** is a stepping stone toward the goal of **Viksit Bharat** (Developed India) by the year **2047**, ensuring the youth are proficient in **New-age Technologies**.
 
• **Skilling Initiatives:** This aligns with the **Skill India Mission** and **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) 4.0**, which focuses on training students in **Coding**, **AI**, **Robotics**, and **Internet of Things (IoT)**.
 
• **Budgetary Focus:** The **Union Budget** presented by Finance Minister **Nirmala Sitharaman** has consistently increased the allocation for **Digital Infrastructure**, emphasizing the role of the **Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)** in social sectors.
 
• **Research Corpus:** A massive corpus of **Rs. 1 lakh crore** has been proposed to provide long-term, low-interest loans for **Research and Innovation** in sunrise sectors, which includes **Educational Technology (EdTech)** and AI.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **National Research Foundation (ANRF):** The **Anusandhan National Research Foundation** is another key body that works alongside these AI CoEs to provide high-level strategic direction for **Scientific Research** in India.
 
• **Personalized Learning:** AI in the **Education** sector is expected to enable **Adaptive Learning**, where the software adjusts the difficulty and style of content based on an individual student’s performance and **Learning Speed**.
 
• **Global Context:** India’s push for AI in **Education** places it among global leaders like the **USA** and **China**, who are also investing heavily in **Educational AI** to maintain a competitive **Human Resource** edge.
 
• **Implementation Date:** The framework for these centres was solidified during the **Full Union Budget 2024-25** presented in **July 2024**, building upon the foundations laid in the **2023** budget speeches.
